title: The Missing Parade Banner
markdown:
Sun Meadow Village was buzzing like happy bees! It was the Big Bright Parade day. Colorful ribbons were already on the lampposts. Penny the piglet wiggled her tail. Beside her, Drift the seal pup wiggled too. He loved parades very much.

"The parade is starting soon!" Penny squeaked. "I can hear music! Happy trumpets and bouncy drums!"

Penny and Drift wanted to see the Big Bright Banner. It was usually at the very front. But the spot was empty. The pole had no banner.

"Oh dear!" said Drift. "The Big Bright Banner is missing! What can we do?"

Penny looked at the empty spot and then at Drift. "We must find it!" she said. "The parade won't be the same without our banner. It makes everyone smile!"

So, Penny and Drift went on their adventure. They walked past flower stalls. The flowers smelled so sweet. They waddled past the cookie shop. Yummy smells made their tummies rumble a little. Everything in the village looked so happy.

"Where could it be?" Drift wondered. Penny sniffed the air. She tried to smell the colorful banner.

Then, they heard a tiny buzz. It was Mrs. Bumble, a kind bee. Her wings shimmered like rainbows. "Hello, Penny! Hello, Drift!" buzzed Mrs. Bumble. "You look like you are searching for something important."

"We are!" said Penny. "We lost the Big Bright Banner! It's for the parade!"

Mrs. Bumble thought for a moment. "Hmm," she hummed. "I did see something long and colorful floating near the Giggleberry Bush this morning. It looked very cheerful!"

"The Giggleberry Bush!" Penny and Drift said together. Their faces lit up. They knew the Giggleberry Bush! It had juicy berries that made them giggle when they ate them. They thanked Mrs. Bumble with happy smiles. Then, they hurried off to the bush, feeling hopeful.

The Giggleberry Bush was a lovely, leafy bush. It always seemed to chuckle softly when the wind blew through its branches. And there it was! Caught gently on the lowest branches was the Big Bright Banner! It was so colorful, like a rainbow. It was a little tangled, but not hurt. The berries nearby seemed to be giggling too!

"We found it!" shouted Drift. He did a happy little slide.

Penny nudged the banner with her nose. Drift used his smooth flippers to gently untangle it from the twigs. They worked together very carefully. Soon, the Big Bright Banner was free! It lay on the grass, looking bright and cheerful.

Penny and Drift held the banner carefully. They rushed back. The music was much louder now. It was a happy, bouncy tune. They arrived at the parade grounds. The first float was just about to start. With a big effort and teamwork, they hung the Big Bright Banner right at the front. Everyone could see it!

The people cheered! "Hooray for Penny and Drift!" they shouted. The parade began. The music filled the bright blue sky. The Big Bright Banner fluttered happily in the sunny breeze. Penny and Drift looked at each other, their tails wiggling with pride. They knew that a small adventure with friends can make a big, bright, wonderful day for everyone.
characters: Penny the piglet, Drift the seal pup
